publications.name: FALCO: Foundation Model Guided Active Learning for Cost-effective Off-road Freespace Detection
publications.publisher: ICRA(International Conference on Robotics and Automation) 2026
publications.summary: This paper proposes FALCO, a novel framework that leverages foundation models to guide active learning for cost-effective off-road freespace detection. By utilizing the rich contextual understanding of foundation models like VLM, FALCO efficiently identifies informative samples for annotation, significantly reducing the labeling effort while maintaining high detection performance.
